# Locally vendored Barlow fonts

Downloaded unmodified on 2026-11-14 from the primary Google Fonts repository.
These are static TrueType files. Both family-specific SIL Open Font Licenses 1.1
are reproduced alongside the fonts as `OFL.txt`. No font CDN is used at runtime.
